notes.text: Phishing protection: checks new and opened mails, warns with a banner and before opening links, optional AI check via NovaBird Helper
Text and QR codes in images and the real type of attachments are checked
Spam detection with blocked and allowed senders (off by default)
Pair with NovaBird Helper without typing the code
Import accounts from Thunderbird on the PC by QR code
Push for new mail can be chosen in the setup wizard
Sync limits in the settings; About page with NovaBird authors, licenses and links
App went back screen by screen and closed while the search index was built
